Kerala Lottery Results Live Updates: Karunya Plus KN-577 Winners For June 19, 2025; First Prize Rs 1 Crore!
Kerala Lottery Results Today Live Updates: Here’s Guessing Numbers for Karunya Plus KN-577 for Thursday, June 19, 2025. Check the full list of winning numbers here from 3 pm.
KERALA JACKPOT LOTTERY KARUNYA PLUS KN-577 RESULT FOR THURSDAY, 19.6.2025, LIVE UPDATES: The Kerala State Lottery Department is set to announce the Karunya Plus KN-577 lottery results on Thursday, June 19. The draw will take place at 3 PM at Gorky Bhavan, located near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram. The jackpot for this draw is Rs 1 crore, while the second and third prizes are Rs 50 lakh and Rs 5 lakh, respectively. To ensure fairness and transparency, an independent panel of judges will supervise the proceedings. Check the Live Updates and Full List of Winning Numbers here from 3 pm.

HOW TO CHECK KARUNYA PLUS KN-577 RESULTS?
To check the Kerala Karunya Plus KN-577 lottery results, visit the official Kerala Lottery Department website at www.keralalottery.info. Winners can also verify their ticket numbers at the Kerala Government Gazette office. For accurate details and official confirmation, it is recommended to contact the Kerala Lottery Department through their authorised channels.
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR PRIZE MONEY?
Participants are advised to verify their ticket numbers against the winning list published in the Kerala Government Gazette. If the ticket number matches, the holder is eligible to claim the corresponding prize. Prize claims must be submitted within 30 days of the result announcement at the Kerala Lottery Office in Thiruvananthapuram. Winners will need to provide the original ticket along with valid identification to receive their prize.
DOCUMENTS REQUIRED TO CLAIM PRIZE MONEY?
A self-attested photocopy of the winning lottery ticket (both front and back sides).
Recent passport-size photographs, signed by the winner and attested by a Gazetted Officer.
A signed copy of the winner’s PAN card for identity and tax verification purposes.
A duly completed prize claim form with a correctly affixed revenue stamp.
A valid government-issued ID proof such as Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Ration card or PAN card.
How to Download the PDF of Karunya Plus KN-577 Winning Numbers:
Visit the official Kerala Lottery websites: www.keralalotteries.info or keralalotteryresult.net.
On the homepage, click the “Karunya Plus KN-577 Result" link.
The complete list of winning numbers will be displayed on the screen.
Find the option to download the results as a PDF file.
Click to download and save the PDF to your device for future reference.
